interface.longDescription: Explore lines, exponents and distance. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Find a line through two points; Combine equal-base powers; Find diagonal distance. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me find a line through two points.

prompts: Help me find a line through two points.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Number Steps: Grade 8 Math workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Find a line through two points. Reproducible inputs: {"x1":2,"y1":3,"x2":6,"y2":11}
positive.prompt: Help me find a line through two points with these supplied values: {"x1":2,"y1":3,"x2":6,"y2":11}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_8_math_line_from_points with the supplied inputs. Returns {"slope":2,"intercept":-1,"points":[{"x":2,"y":3},{"x":6,"y":11}]}. Shows the actual plot result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me combine equal-base powers with these supplied values: {"base":2,"first":3,"second":4,"rule":"product"}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_8_math_exponent_rules with the supplied inputs. Returns {"base":2,"exponent":7,"value":128,"rule":"product"}. Shows the actual equation result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me find diagonal distance with these supplied values: {"horizontal":6,"vertical":8}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_8_math_pythagorean_distance with the supplied inputs. Returns {"squares":[36,64],"distance":10}. Shows the actual triangle result. Does not fabricate external data.
